name: Shimizu Kaito
source:
A boy filled with self-doubt

He hides the large scar on the left side of his face by wearing flashy hair and accessories.
Despite his appearance, he is passive and has difficulty with social situations.
It takes a long time to understand what he says, as he speaks in poetry rather than words.
He has abandonment issues from being ghosted by his former bandmate who had previously accepted him...

"Because of this shadowed scar, I was ostracized and labeled a 'germ'."

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507560/_/]Steam page[/url]]
